It shouldn't be too difficult for you to train in Chaos Castle. I have a quest for you. One through which you can earn the items you'll need in Chaos Castle.... Will you accept? (Basic character: Level 180-239, Advanced character: Level 160-219)
It sounds like an easy job...
It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?

It wouldn't be easy to attack Gaion hiding in Varka. You'd better eliminate Raymond and Erkanne first to weaken his power. Without these two Gaion will not be as invincible. Go to Varka, kill Raymond and Erkanne and come back to me to get the reward from the guild.
It's becoming more and more difficult. I accept the mission. (Accept)
It's easier than anticipated.
It's fighting spirit this time? I accept the mission. (Accept)
It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?
It's possible to find out the location of myself and others using coordinates? Amazing!
It's the quartermaster unit's job. (Refuse)
It's time for you to test your limits at Chaos Castle. Go see the Shadow Phantom Soldier, test your limitations, and then take the Chaos Castle challenge.
It's too late to pull out now....

It's very easy to enter Blood Castle. The battle event takes place every two hours from 12:30am and on. To enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel in Devias, five minutes before a Blood Castle event commences and ask to join. The Messenger of Archangel will then send you to the castle.

It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.

It's very easy to enter Devil Square. It can be entered every four hours from 3:00 a.m. and on (3:00 a.m., 7:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 3:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 11:00 p.m.). To enter, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before a scheduled entry time and ask to join. Charon will then send you to Devil Square.

It's very easy to enter Illusion Temple. It can be entered every four hours from 01:00 a.m. and on: 01:00 a.m., 05:00 a.m., 09:00 a.m., 01:00 p.m., 05:00 p.m., and 09:00 p.m. To enter, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before an Illusion Temple event commences and ask to join. Mirage will then send you to the temple.
Join Gens Duprian.
Join Gens Vanert.
Just say the word!
Keeping the peace of the hero

Kundun's Royal Guards, however, continue to attack the barrier, and are weakening it. We need Archangel's weapon in order to prevent this weakening of the barrier, and that's why we are now seeking the help of travelers.

Kundun, however, must've anticipated such a move. He hid beyond the range of the barrier and eliminated the Twelve Saints as soon as the barrier was formed. Luckily, Archangel evaded that peril and sacrificed himself for the barrier.
Kundun… He's a hard target…
Ladies' appetite for collecting
Leave Gens Duprian.
Leave Gens Vanert.
Let me give it a go. (Accept)
Let me give you a Dark Knight weapon to use so that you can understand better.
Let me give you a Dark Wizard's scroll to use so that you can understand better.
Let me give you a Summoner's scroll to use so that you can understand better.
Let me give you an Agility Elf weapon to use so that you can understand how skills work better.
Let me give you an Energy Elf's orb to use so that you can understand how skills work better.
Let's get you some real combat experience.
Let's hear it.

Loud and clear! Give me the next quest!
Lurkers in the Dark
Many of the monsters that attacked our barrier have been dealt with, but their superiors are now physically attacking the barrier. Will you eliminate these monsters for us? (Level 200-209)

Many travelers are disappearing from the Swamp of Peace because of Shadow Knights. Go to the Swamp of Peace and defeat 140 Shadow Knights. Come see me once that's done to receive a Devil's Invitation + 7 as a reward. They are strong foes, and you should hunt them with the help of others.
May I help you? My collection is much more diverse than the ordinary merchants. That's the secret of my success, haha.
May the glory be with you… Good job. It must be the enemy clan who's controlling these Hero monsters. We need to attack them in revenge immediately. Will you take this job? (Lv. 350 - 400)
May the glory be with you… Good job. We found an evidence of the enemy clan from the investigation. We need to attack them in revenge immediately. Will you take this job? (Lv. 350 - 400)
May the grace of Lugard be with you… This is the entrance to the Underwater Temple. Kundun's army is captivated in this temple by the sealed stone.

Mega Crusts in Icarus are causing great harm to travelers. Go to Icarus and defeat 80 Mega Crusts. Come see me when that's done to receive an Invisibility Cloak + 4 as a reward. At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.

Mega Crusts who rank higher than Alquamoses, are planning something in Icarus. Whatever they are planning, it will likely harm our reconnaissance party. Will you help eliminate more of these Mega Crusts? (Level 250-254)
Members of our reconnaissance party continue to lose their lives to Iron Wheels. Will you help eliminate more of these Iron Wheels? (Level 240-244)
Members of our reconnaissance party continue to lose their lives to the slashes of Bloody Wolves. Will you help eliminate more of these Bloody Wolves? (Level 235-239)
Mercenary Guild Office?
Mercenary's request varies depending on the day of the week. Please check the location and task before you start. (Lv. 350 - 400)
Monster Supply Route in Devias!
Monster hunting is my specialty....
Monsters are continuing to hamper advancement into Icarus. Go meet with the Shadow Phantom Soldier.
Monsters are posing a threat to the safe zone once again. Go meet with the Shadow Phantom Soldier.
Monsters are still trying to mobilize and set a blockade on the path to Icarus. Will you help eliminate more of these monsters? (Level 220-229)

Monsters are taking over the Dungeon in Lorencia once again. Our reconnaissance party is too busy dealing with monsters and can't make prompt reports. I wish to ask for your help with this matter. Will you accept this quest? (Level 91-100)
Monsters have started attacking the soldiers again. Go meet with the Shadow Phantom Soldier.

Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.

Much of the evil energy from the Lost Tower has subsided, but the guardians at the tower are struggling to cope with a sudden increase in monsters. I have a quest that will help them. Will you accept this quest? (Level 190-193)
My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the Elf queen. I am happy to make your acquaintance.
NPC dialog script error!
New request for you hasn't been delivered yet. You can start a new request after 24 hours since a request has been cleared. Please come back after that.
No more. Going any further is beyond me. (Refuse)
No, I don't want to. (Refuse)
No, I need some rest first. (Refuse)
No. I will give it more thought.
Not at all. It's only natural to work for the clan. (Accept)

Now that the defense of the supply route has weakened, it's time to stir up the enemy's command structure a bit more. I'd like to ask you to defeat the high-ranking monsters that control those in charge of the supply route. Will you accept this quest? (Level 46-55)

Of course...

Oh! Thanks to your bravery, we were able to crush those good-for-nothing Duprians once again. This is a reward bestowed to you by Vanert Reicht himself for your contributions in battle. I hope to see you in action once again next month.
Oh! That will surely come in handy!
Oh! You wish to become a member of Gens Duprian? Share our virtues of honor and respect, and help in the fight to crush the greed of Gens Vanert and find the stone that will seal away Kundun.
Oh, I didn't recognize how strong you are and gave you a wrong request. Would you give me back the Lv. 1 Letter of Request?
Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.
Oh, already gone...
Oh, there are different requests depending on the day of the week.

Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Icarus asking for help repelling Alquamoses and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Icarus, kill 20 Alquamoses and find 1 Crystal Sword (Attack power +12). I will reward you when you bring me the sword.

Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Icarus asking for help repelling Alquamoses and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Icarus, kill 20 Alquamoses and find 1 Sword of Destruction (Attack power +12). I will reward you when you bring me the sword.

Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Kanturu Ruins asking for help repelling Splinter Wolves and finding the training material for recruits. Kill 20 Splinter Wolves and find 1 Ancient Stick (Wizardry damage +12). I will reward you when you bring me the stick.

Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert asking for help repelling Mutants and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Tarkan, kill 20 Mutants and find 1 Staff of Resurrection (Wizardry damage +12). I will reward you when you bring me the staff.

Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert asking for help repelling Mutants and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Tarkan, kill 20 Mutants and find 10 Unirias. I will reward you when you bring me the Unirias.
Ok, I will head for Aida at once. (Accept)
Ok, I will take care of him right away. (Accept)
Ok, I'll give it a try. (Accept)
Ok, I'll try it. (Accept)
Ok, I'm ready. (Accept)

One of the places our reconnaissance party hasn't been able to reach is the Tarkan desert. The reasons behind their failure include the harsh environment and most importantly the monsters known as Mutants. Will you eliminate these Mutants to allow our reconnaissance party to advance? (Level 230-234)

Our continued assault on the Dungeon has secured a somewhat secure entryway. However, there are still monsters hindering the efforts of our reconnaissance party. Will you accept this quest? (Level 141-160)

Our entry into the Floating Castle has been hampered mostly by Queen Rainiers. It appears Queen Rainiers are controlling Mega Crusts and Alquamoses from behind the scenes. I wish to ask for your help in eliminating these Queen Rainiers. Will you accept? (Level 255-259)
Our forces in Kanturu Ruins are under attack. Eliminate 50 Splinter Wolves and return to me for a reward.
Our reconnaissance party reports of severe resistance from monsters at Dungeon Level 2. I'd like to ask you to do away with these monsters. Will you accept this quest? (Level 111-120)

Our reconnaissance party reports that some low-ranking monsters are causing quite a headache for them. I wish to ask for your help in eliminating these monsters. Will you accept this quest? (Level 161-165)

Our reconnaissance party reports that stolen supplies are being sent to Kundun's army. Please defeat the monsters controlling these plunderers while we ascertain the location of the supply route. Will you accept this quest? (Level 26-35)

Our reconnaissance party reports the Army of Darkness formed by Gorgons has lost much of its might. This is the moment you've carried out all these quests for. It's now time to strike the final blow against the Army of Darkness. Will you accept this quest? (Level 141-160)
Outside Devias, you'll encounter white monsters known as Worms. Defeat 25 Worms and return to me for a reward.

Packs of Iron Wheels often attack travelers in Tarkan. Go to Tarkan and hunt down 100 Iron Wheels. Come see me afterwards to receive a Devil's Invitation + 4 as a reward. They are strong foes, and you should hunt them with the help of others.
Party request?

At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.
Plunderers are too much for me to handle. (Refuse)
